title: CAH native image to local project
summary: Generate an image in the owning Worker, upload the original through a user-selected Drive relay, download it with the current Managed request, and verify the local file.

intents: 将 CAH Worker 原生生成的图片原件保存到本地工程
reuse verified native image to Drive to normal Managed Runner transfer
constraints: Use the current task authorization, available native-image and Drive tools, and a user-selected destination.
Keep the original file and apply the current task cleanup policy.

procedure.instruction: Follow the reusable guide using the current task inputs and output directory.
